description: This file manages session metadata for the 'acp' component, including loading, resolving, listing, and updating session entries related to 'acp' within a session store.

classes.name: AcpSessionStoreEntry
classes.description: Type representing an entry in the ACP session store, including configuration, store path, session keys, and optional session and ACP metadata.

methods.name: loadSessionStoreRuntime
methods.description: Lazily loads the session store runtime module.

methods.name: resolveStoreSessionKey
methods.description: Resolves the correct session key from the store, handling normalization and case-insensitivity.

methods.name: resolveSessionStorePathForAcp
methods.description: Resolves the configuration and store path for a given session key.

methods.name: readAcpSessionEntry
methods.description: Reads a specific ACP session entry from the store based on session key.

methods.name: listAcpSessionEntries
methods.description: Lists all ACP session entries across all session store targets.

methods.name: upsertAcpSessionMeta
methods.description: Updates or inserts ACP session metadata in the store based on a mutation function.
